title: Companion native stream follow
description: Start native-stream-stack.mts (isolated gateway, synthetic Claude runner) pair the app once with `native-stream-proof.mjs pair`, and set NATIVE_STREAM_CONTROL, NATIVE_STREAM_STATE (a new file), METRO_PORT and IOS_SIMULATOR. Proves through the real composer, scroll and Latest controls that the virtualized conversation follows a 200-delta stream, stops following when the reader scrolls away, counts unseen output, jumps back with Latest, and keeps the reader's place when they open a message.

proofTargets.claim: The selected conversation renders its rows.
A reader at the end stays at the end while a turn streams.
Scrolling away stops following and new entries count as unseen.
Latest returns to the end and follows again.
Opening a message does not scroll the conversation to its end.

open.intent: Open the session by deep link and wait for its history.

at-end.intent: The rows render and the reader starts at their end.

assert-at-end.intent: The at-end phase passed its checks.

streams-following.intent: Every sample while 200 deltas stream follows the end, and the turn ends there.

assert-streams-following.intent: The streams-following phase passed its checks.

scrolled-away.intent: A flick back toward the start stops following.

assert-scrolled-away.intent: The scrolled-away phase passed its checks.

more-output.intent: Turns from another client arrive while away and count as unseen.

assert-more-output.intent: The more-output phase passed its checks.

wait-latest.intent: The Latest control shows the unseen count.

latest.intent: Latest lands at the end, follows again and clears unseen.

assert-latest.intent: The latest phase passed its checks.
